scenarios.title: Onboard an authenticated Copilot Studio agent

prerequisites: Use a disposable Power Platform environment and licensed maker.
Provide AI Administrator, u-allow, and a separate signed-out browser session.
setup: Create Studio Guide with a name under 42 characters.
Use Authenticate with Microsoft; publish only to the approved test group.
Load public-procedure.txt as approved synthetic knowledge.
positive_steps: Locate the draft identity and registry entry before publication.
Publish, install as u-allow, and request the public approval code in a new Teams conversation.
negative_steps: Open the published channel in the signed-out browser session.
Attempt the public request without authentication; verify sign-in is required before agent content is delivered.
expected: Creation registers an identity; authenticated authorized use returns POC-APPROVAL-6142.
The supported Microsoft channel requires authentication; the signed-out session receives no agent knowledge response.
evidence: Capture draft and published IDs, deployment scope, authentication settings, response, and sign-in requirement.

value: Measure onboarding minutes and deployed-user count.
Count unauthenticated access attempts prevented.
cleanup: Remove test deployment and knowledge; restore prior access settings.
Delete only the disposable agent after evidence collection.

scenarios.title: Deploy and publish a Foundry hosted agent

Open the published Teams agent as u-allow; match its registry entry and published identity.
negative_steps: Open the Just you publication link as u-deny without project authorization.
Attempt invocation; inspect authorization failure and verify no completed inference for that request.
expected: Authorized invocation runs the selected hosted version.

evidence: Capture deployment version, project RBAC, publication identity, invocation response, and rejected request.

pass_criteria: Both phases require live-product artifacts and matching endpoint side effects.
Do not substitute Application Insights traces for Agent 365 observability.
value: Measure deployment and publication minutes.
Count unauthorized invocations denied and identities mapped.
cleanup: Remove the test publication and restore project role assignments.
Stop and delete only test resources after evidence collection.
